title: Integriq data feed declaration
description: The shape of lib/Settings/feeds.json in an app that asks integriq to serve its data feeds (openspec/changes/gateway-declared-data-feeds, REQ-DDF-001). Each feed becomes one read-only, paged endpoint at /api/endpoint/feeds/<app>/<key>. Mirrored rule for rule by lib/Service/Feed/FeedDeclarationValidator.php.

app.description: The declaring app's id. When present it must be the app that ships the file.

key.description: Stable dataset key; the last path segment of the feed URL.

fields.description: The fields a feed answers with: the privacy boundary the app reviewed.

filter.description: Fixed equality filters applied to every request, such as only posted lines.

scope.description: The query parameter a caller names its scope with and the field it filters; a consumer reads only the values bound to it.
